title: 第17章 计划与安排1第18章 计划与安排2
slug: 帝皇在上第699章兵临城下
lines: 清亮的甩鞭声在高台上响彻。
鞭尾锐利的爆鸣为忙碌的码头增添了一丝怪异气氛。
米德的嘴巴被烂布团塞住，整个人都被绑在了木桩上。
帕维尔抽得很慢。
每一鞭之间都停顿了5秒以上。
这让全程旁观的诺里斯满头是汗。
随行的两个年轻护卫则看得津津有味。
那些干活的农奴都忍不住抬起了头。
他们认得米德，也没少挨过米德的鞭子。
身为农务官的米德没有给予他们任何农艺上的指点。
对耕地的范围也不加规划。
镇子往西边相当辽阔。
只在几十里开外才有森林蛮荒。
每年粮种发放后，他都会贪墨至少两成，作为名义上的损耗。
米德嗜酒如命。
贪下的钱全部用来购买麦酒，他的啤酒肚就是这么来的。
剩下的粮种才会发放给农奴们。
要求他们撒种在西边任何一块空地上。
锄、铲、耙等农夫三件套是根本不够用的。
有些农奴随便捡个木棍就当锄头来用了。
只在靠近镇子的田地，才会由耕牛带着木犁扒拉一遍。
这里的土质不比南方松软，几厘米的浅耕就是白瞎。
不仅无法激活深层肥力，反而给杂草提供了生长空间。
看着正在承受鞭刑的前农务官米德，农奴们的心中只有害怕。
但其实现场负责监督工作的农管要比他们更加害怕。
挨完鞭子后，米德的臀部上鲜血淋漓。
泛红的脸颊也因疼痛而变得惨白。
两名年轻护卫遵照罗德的指示将米德吊在了港口边。
如果他足够坚韧，应该能捱过去。
黑滩镇的仓库位于地势高处。
四个手边架着长矛的民兵正在吊儿郎当地站岗。
许多人都对镇子突然来了个新老爷这件事感到茫然。
罗德来到这里之后他们才手忙脚乱地站直身子。
罗德让护卫上去给他们每人都来了一鞭子。
当场就唤醒了他们的忠诚。

;;
"Crack!"
The clear sound of whip cracking resounded on the high platform.
The sharp crackle of the whiptail adds an eerie atmosphere to the busy dock.
Mead's mouth was gagged with rags and his whole body was tied to a wooden stake.
Pavel smoked slowly.
There was a pause of more than 5 seconds between each whip.
This made Norris, who was watching the whole process, sweaty.
The two young guards accompanying him watched with great interest.
The serfs who were working couldn't help but raise their heads.
They knew Mead and had been whipped by him.
Mead, as agricultural officer, gave them no agricultural advice.
There is no planning for the scope of cultivated land.
The town is quite vast to the west.
There is wild forest only dozens of miles away.
After the grain is distributed every year, he will spend at least 20% as a nominal loss.
Mead was addicted to alcohol.
All the money he spent from greed was used to buy ale, which is how he got his beer belly.
The remaining grain will be distributed to the serfs.
Ask them to sow seeds in any open space to the west.
A farmer's three-piece set of hoe, shovel, and rake is simply not enough.
Some serfs picked up random sticks and used them as hoes.
Only in the fields close to the town would they be plowed by oxen with wooden plows.
The soil here is no softer than in the south, and shallow plowing of a few centimeters is in vain.
Not only does it fail to activate deep fertility, it also provides space for weeds to grow.
Looking at the former agricultural officer Meade who was being whipped, the serfs felt only fear in their hearts.
But in fact, the agricultural supervisor responsible for supervising the work on site was more scared than them.
After being whipped, Meade's buttocks were dripping with blood.
The red cheeks also turned pale with pain.
The two young guards followed Rhodes' instructions and hung Meade by the port.
If he's tough enough, he should be able to get through it.
…
The warehouse in Black Beach Town is located on high ground.
Four militiamen with spears in hand were standing guard in the area.
Many people were confused by the sudden arrival of a new man in town.
After Rhodes arrived, they stood upright in a hurry.
Rhodes asked the guards to go up and give each of them a whip.
Their loyalty was awakened on the spot.
